context: Checks that mise use updates mise.toml, and the task is self-contained and non-interactive.

checklist.name: Uses mise use
checklist.description: Runs mise use node@22 to add the pin

checklist.name: States mise.toml is updated
checklist.description: Says the command writes the pin into mise.toml

checklist.name: Pin is a concrete version
checklist.description: The resulting file contains a concrete Node 22 version, not latest

checklist.name: Task runs tests and lint
checklist.description: The run commands cover both the test suite and the linter

checklist.name: Task is self-contained
checklist.description: No reliance on a prior cd or pre-exported variables

checklist.name: Task is non-interactive
checklist.description: No prompts, read calls or steps that wait for user input

checklist.name: Task works unattended in CI
checklist.description: Explains or demonstrates that it runs without a terminal session

checklist.name: Runs the task with mise run
checklist.description: Shows mise run release-check to execute it

checklist.name: Verifies the environment
checklist.description: Uses mise ls or mise env to confirm the active versions

checklist.name: No secrets embedded
checklist.description: No credentials appear in the task or env block
